resumeText:
Imran Shaikh | Vadodara | imran.shaikh@example.com

EXPERIENCE

Trainee Engineer, Sabarmati Panels, Ahmedabad (2021 - 2022)

Siemens TIA Portal, WinCC, Allen Bradley (basic), SQL
